title.en: A Database Next to the Tests

hints.tr: `services:` işin içinde, `runs-on` ile `steps` arasında; `postgres:` onun bir alt satırı.
hints.en: `services:` goes inside the job, between `runs-on` and `steps`; `postgres:` is one level under it.

hints.tr: `options: >-` sonraki satırları tek satır gibi birleştirir; üç seçenek alt alta.
hints.en: `options: >-` joins the following lines as one line; the three options one under another.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
        ports:
          - "5432:5432"
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:test@localhost:5432/postgres
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
        ports:
          - "5432:5432"
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest -q
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:test@localhost:5432/postgres
```
